name: longcat_refine
prompt: A woman sits at a wooden table by the window in a cozy café. She reaches out with her right hand, picks up the white coffee cup from the saucer, and gently brings it to her lips to take a sip. After drinking, she places the cup back on the table and looks out the window, enjoying the peaceful atmosphere.
execution_note: 非默认：refine_target_size=[1024,1024]，我们增加的可选目标画布配置，用于与官方 LongCat benchmark 对齐，替代原生方形 960×960 bucket；不改变插值、补帧、BSA、调度或 VAE。显式启用 refinement BSA（sparsity=0.9375，Q/K tile444）和本地转换的 refinement LoRA，强度1。输入为校验一致的原始 uint8 93×640×640 帧，输出186×1024×1024、30fps。沿用其他 FastVideo 测试的 pin_cpu_memory=false 兼容设置；DiT 按层 offload、文本编码器/VAE CPU offload 及 compile 均保留原生默认。视频编码器保留 FastVideo 默认，不强行匹配官方 writer 的 CRF。
